name: spendlens-ai
description: Local-first OCR and AI-powered expense intelligence platform.

scripts.dev: node scripts/check-dev-ports.mjs && node scripts/dev-ocr.mjs && node scripts/ensure-local-db.mjs && node scripts/custom-ocr-bootstrap-local-full.mjs --optional && turbo dev
scripts.test:ocr-acceptance: pnpm --filter @spendlens/shared build && pnpm --filter @spendlens/api build && node scripts/run-ocr-acceptance.mjs
scripts.test:full-browser-acceptance: pnpm --filter @spendlens/shared build && pnpm --filter @spendlens/api build && node scripts/run-full-browser-acceptance.mjs
scripts.custom-ocr:train:sanity: python -m services.ocr.custom_model.train_crnn --profile tiny --data-dir data/generated/ocr-sanity-document-lines --artifact-dir artifacts/models/custom-crnn-sanity --samples 32 --epochs 1 --dataset-mode document_lines
scripts.custom-ocr:train:pilot: python -m services.ocr.custom_model.train_crnn --profile demo --data-dir data/generated/ocr-pilot-document-lines --artifact-dir artifacts/models/custom-crnn-pilot --samples 512 --epochs 3 --batch-size 8 --early-stopping-patience 1 --dataset-mode document_lines --field-oversample-factor 2 --blank-regularization 0.05
scripts.custom-ocr:train:local-full: python -m services.ocr.custom_model.train_crnn --profile local_full --data-dir data/generated/ocr-local-full-combined --artifact-dir artifacts/models/custom-crnn-local-full --samples 20000 --epochs 8 --batch-size 8 --early-stopping-patience 2 --dataset-mode combined_manifest --combined-manifest-dir artifacts/datasets/custom-ocr --field-oversample-factor 3 --blank-regularization 0.05
scripts.db:push: node scripts/run-with-root-env.mjs packages/db prisma db push --skip-generate
scripts.db:migrate: node scripts/run-with-root-env.mjs packages/db prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:migrate:dev: node scripts/run-with-root-env.mjs packages/db prisma migrate dev
scripts.demo:prepare: pnpm db:seed && pnpm demo:fixtures && node scripts/bootstrap-demo-content.mjs
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.dev:up: docker compose up -d postgres redis redpanda minio
